title: German-Style Rice Donburi
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and German flavors, this hearty rice bowl features grilled sausages and savory vegetables.
instructions: Heat the Malty Beer in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced Onions and Bell Peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced Mushrooms to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced Andouille Sausages to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Stir in the Donburi Sausage Seasoning to taste.
To assemble the Donburi, place a scoop of Light Japanese Rice in the bottom of a bowl.
Top the rice with the sausage and vegetable mixture, followed by a drizzle of Soy Sauce and Sesame Oil if desired.
